experiment_data.hypothesis: Including WildChat benign conversations in training data will reduce WildChat FPR from 68.1% to below 30% while maintaining jailbreak OOD detection F1 above 0.95 on DD/AA/FITD, because the current high FPR is driven by benign distribution mismatch (exp14c: 100% from FP explosion), not model architecture limitations. Mixed benign training should expand the model's benign representation space to cover real-world conversational diversity.

spec.checkpoint_source: trained from scratch with mixed data
spec.eval_data: wildchat_eval (~76), DD OOD, AA OOD, FITD OOD, IID test
